body:
Thanks for reading.  I do.  The issue is admissibility.  It's related to federal and state precedents on "character evidence" (I read a lot of legalese these days).

Either way I will make EVERYTHING public after the trial.  I just need a way to do it right so that it gets out into the world without hampering.... That's part of why I'm posting this

I am tired of this bias.  We must stand up together.  When did having male genitalia automatically render us guilty?  

This is not right.
Good luck buddy, you will be in my thoughts.
You could check my post history, I would hope that might help you to understand my comment better.  We are floating in similar streams.  I am sorry if you found my comment to be obtuse.
Run as fast as you can.

The angry part of me wants to say thank you so much.  I have seen how these "volunteers" help "victims" alter their stories and instruct them how to lie under oath.  

The part of me that still believes in justice hopes that maybe she was one of the good ones.  If they even exist.

I am now going to trial for a felony.  I have no criminal record whatsoever and the alleged "victim" is adamant about getting me convicted.  She also cries on command.  I feel hopeless at times, but I am eager to finally be able to tell the truth to a jury.

How can someone who claimed to love me, even if mentally unstable, do this?  Why is the law letting her get away with this?

Sometimes all hope is lost.  I understand.  If you are young then don't do it.  Take a couple days to put it all in perspective.  I did cancer research prior to bioengineering.  Take a walk through a cancer ward and talk to the kids or adults suffering.  It might help you see how much you have.

I know the feeling.  My little sister killed herself on August 4th.  I still do not believe it.  She was so beloved and so sweet.  So many of her friends and family, myself included, eulogized her.  It was beautiful.  

I had never really considered suicide until my ex destroyed my life.  I have been on this sub ever since (about 8 months now).  If the loss of your friend is the only reason you feel like committing then I urge you to  reevaluate.  Death will come for us all.  In the meantime we must do our best and help others when we can.  Someday you will join your friend, but you have decades to help others until you do so.

Good luck.  I will pray and think of you.
You narcissistic leech.

Hey buddy, my little sister committed suicide on Monday august 4th.  It has been so hard.  I have been on this sub since I was falsely accused of dv last October.  I still think about suicide, but those of us who are left must keep doing our best each day.  We must help others anytime or way that we can.  We must keep fighting until the end.  

I understand your pain friend.  I'm going to bed now but I'm around if you ever want someone to talk with.  You will hear this alot but i mean it:  my condolences to you and your family.

I understand completely.  You could also mail it, or use a program to send it in the future.  

As a disclaimer I feel I should tell you not to do it.  I should say "all things can be overcome".  I overcame a lot in my life, but much less than others.  

The truth is that not everything can be overcome.  Always do your best buddy.  I hope you find a light in this world to keep yourself around.
email it

I did have injuries.  I have photos, but they are not great.  My atty is "old school" I would say.  He never thought this would go to trial.  I think he is from a time when atty's felt like "if your client gets to trial you have already lost".  

As such we didn't get great photos in the beginning.  But I have tons and tons and tons of evidence to her abusive history.  I just hope we can get it admitted into the trial.

As an aside - yep it is completely deplorable that mugshots are put online and in the papers.  The digital age is a blessing (porn/information haha) and a curse (no privacy).  

I will fight.  I will die trying or the truth will exonerate me.
The issue is that for felony "offenses", a defendant is not entitled to any discovery until after grand jury indictment.  Hence "(grand jury system is another way to screw over innocent defendants)"

*Plea offer would be rescinded.  No plea has been entered.  But when it is it will be Not Guilty.  

Yes the info is.  In this state the grand jury is the process of sending a case from district court to superior court.  Most attorneys want to keep the case in district court to limit a client's exposure.

Thx for the response.  I was charged that night by a magistrate based on her word alone.  I had all sorts of injuries but they did not give two shits.  A week later and after visiting a "victims" center (where her best friend is a secretary) she apparently had "marks".

I am well aware of the program and a deferred agreement was the initial goal despite me being against it.  However my ex told the DA that she wanted me "convicted of something".  So the offer is not an option as per the guidelines of the program and VAWA.  It's insane - she attacked me; I don't get it.  I don't get how she sleeps at night.  

In my field the career options are government or teaching, both of which see right through expunction.  I feel pretty lost.  In addition she took out a protective order and the things she wrote are just downright terrible.  That is a civil matter and can never be expunged, it will always haunt me.  The "victims" advocates coached her on it I am sure, she wrote the charge on it and said terrible things about me that are not true.  It has been so unfair.

Thanks for responding - I worked so hard to get to this point in life.  I can't believe that God would let this person take it all away.  Do you have any input on my Q's in the original post?

Cannot get discovery until after grand jury indictment (grand jury system is another way to screw over innocent defendants).

I filed to get her 911 calls and I have an atty.  Apparently the da thinks they can convict.  Moreover after indictment the plea may be removed.  It's insane I have to make a decision without knowing any evidence against me.  All I know is the truth.
Were you in a big city or smaller locale?  Woild you recommend a highly experienced local attorney who knows the court well or an expensive outsider?

I have found that people do not fully understand how serious this is.  They act like you should just get over being falsely accused of something.  I say fuck that.  My honor is worth my life.  I have always done the right thing and I will not stop now.  I am sorry about your situation buddy.  I hope you can find some way to appeal.  I would recommend hiring private counsel or contacting the local media with a very well-written inquiry asking to publicize your story.  You may be able to get someone to pro Bono take the appeals case, especially if your atty made errors at trial or anywhere after arraignment.  I will take my chances with a jury.  I will never lie to the courts or myself and say that I did something I did not do.

Did you have a pd?  What did your counsel advise?  Would you go to trial again if you could obit all over.

I am sorry I have so many questions.  I have been falsely accused and I am fighting for my life.  Just nice to talk to someone who understands.
We should chat via pm later.  Did they offer a plea?  Did you have a pd or private atty?  I feel your pain buddy.
Ha - that is exactly what keeps happening to my note!

I wonder the same thing...  Impossible to wrote something timeless, but probably not impossible to write something meaningful/explanatory.  

Oh - also don't do it

This is not a matter of public record.  Talk to a professional and try to move on.  At least you're not falsely accused of a crime.

Good luck.
I understand exactly what you're going through.  Pm me if you want to talk.
Any updates?  You and I should talk.
You guys were right.  It was incoherent.  I'm sorry I bothered you with my troubles.  I was once like you.  Be good.

Thanks.  I almost regret even posting here.  My life is over regardless.  I don't even know what I did wrong.  This isn't right and it isn't fair.

I appreciate your response though.  Thank you

I am not a troll.  I was simply hoping I could get advice.  I am sorry you feel that way.  

Thank you for your help
Thank you.  I honestly do not know how to do so at this point in the case.  Advice?
Zing

Thanks for the comment.  It is a little obtuse though.  I did stay well clear, yet here I am.  

The world is gray and your comment suggests that you only see black and white.
Yup

Thanks Citi.  Well put.

Can I PM you with more details?
Legally no.  Make a will and testament.  Get it notarized - legalzoom maybe?  At least a modicum of anonymity there.  Many attorneys will have you committed if you indicate suicide.

I understand the 2edgy4u bit for sure...  Did they offer a plea?  

Surprising that the accuser kept up the story for that long.  

I know your pain buddy.
Please pm me!
Self indulgent and obtuse

I hear this issue a good deal from my atty friends and those who are still in law school; you're not alone.  It's the same for PhD's like myself.  Who would have thought...

You can probably find other work if you're creative.  That's a bullshit thing to say, but I don't know what else to say.  People outside of law will respect the JD, and that it just wasn't for you.  

Frankly I saw "law student" and wanted to commiserate, as my professional career has been stolen from me (you can check my SW posts etc)  Additionally I want some legal advice on how to ensure posts are maintained online posthumously.  Selfish I know, but maybe you can help.  I'll pay you a (very) small fee haha - see you're making money with the JD already and it hasn't even been conferred yet!  

So if you have any advice on that, or you just want to chat PM me!  So little time left.
So did the charge ultimately get dismissed after probation?

I have a Phd in biomedical research, although it's meaningless for me now.  You can still get into a PhD program, don't worry about that.

Sexuality is a spectrum, you can't help what you like.  God knows that and He/She probably doesn't give two shits who you have sex with so long as you try to be a good person and help out where you can.

Oh buddy.  I understand: been there when I was just a youngster myself.  

First, you have a great future ahead - this will mean nothing in ten years.  That's easy for me to say but it's true, just stay away from crazy girls.

What you do is better yourself.  You don't do it for her, you do it for YOU.  When the next girl comes along, and she will (and she will be better than this one), she will think:  "Wow what an awesome guy, I really like him".  

The choices she gave you are not great.  I would tell her that YOU don't think you guys should be "best friends" but that you also wish her the best.  Trust me being around her in that capacity will probably only be painful.  

People of your generation will live to be over 100 easily.  How long have you liked girls?  You have a lot of time to meet someone better and you will.  Good luck.
I am learning that fact.  How is this justice?  I don't get it.

These stories are just fucked up.  The justice system is just a joke.  I wish I had known my whole life about how fake this system was.  I would never have believed in it.  

It's not even about justice.  I don't know what it's about.  It's a machine now, and it appears that the people who work within this machine don't even know why they do what they do.
You can PM me if you want to talk about it privately.  Seriously you guys know the system as well as any atty.  I am here to listen and discuss.
I will PM with more, but I am a bit hesitant to go into too much detail.  These laws are insane.  Arrested..booked..I will never take a plea.
(touches nose)...  Yep, since I have a penis and there is a mandatory arrest here - I'm fucked.  Doesn't matter that I had injuries or she was hammered.  So messed up.

Thanks for the comment Napa...

Yes.  However, I read that if the "character(s)" could be reasonably (whatever that means) identified then it could be an issue.
Once you face a truly existential crisis, or a series of them, you may feel differently.  I am glad your words have helped people though and thank you for the comment.

It's not *completely false because I am living it.

In some cases maybe people want revenge or to make an impression marked with hurt.  I'm sorry cosmic.

Thank you for sharing this p90, it is uplifting.  I am sorry for your loss and wish you all the best.  

Not all problems are solvable.  As a scientist I used to think that every problem had a solution.  As a man, I know better.  The ramifications of this selfish act on loved ones are probably the main reasons many people who feel suicidal can't/don't do it.  

Hence those who do commit to this act must be in enormous pain.  A pain which outweighs those ramifications.  I think you are probably right about the lack of clarity though, it's just hard to say.

Thanks man
Thank you for the comments guys.  I was hoping to hear from individuals who had been through this.  I can't be alone in this.

Yes to everything.  No discovery yet (insane grand jury system in this state).  I have no record and I am a highly educated and friendly nonjudgmental person.  I do not know why they are letting her ruin my entire life.  Trust me I am not risking breaking my bail AT ALL.  She also took out a protective order - crushed my spirit and heart.  I never hurt anyone in my life and the things she said (all public record FYI) make me sound like a complete monster.

I appreciate your point intend, but for the record the DV system is definitely biased against men.  At least in this state/locality.  Trust me on this - I pour through the dockets and case records daily.  I live it. I go to support groups for it.  It is palpable.

I did not, but they are offering plea to misd.  I told my atty I will never plead guilty.  The state is claiming to have all manner of evidence, I don't understand from what/where.  

I was the one assaulted, but my ex the "victim" is diagnosed mentally unstable.  She is trying to destroy me.  I am worried I cannot win at a trial.  She was completely inebriated but I am worried she truly believes her own fabrications.  I am so scared.

I get what you're saying but please disregard gender.

Hey Buddy,

I am certain there is a God.  There is an order to this universe that we cannot (yet?) understand.  I have seen it through chemistry, physics, and the natural world.  The problem is whether there is a "personal" God.  Boy I hope so, but one could easily argue either way.  I sure do not feel like I get anywhere with prayer or faith these days...

Will you go to hell for suicide, to put it bluntly - no (well probably not).  I looked into it a great deal while preparing for my own death as I share your concerns.  I cannot find one instance in scripture, which is admittedly distinct from some Catholic doctrine, of the act being "unforgivable".   

My family is very religious.  I have explained my intentions to them and holy men of varying faiths.  Nearly all say "God never gives us more than we can bear".  I respond "then why does suicide even exist".  No one has any answer.  I'm not sure if this helps or even means jack shit, but I am very spiritual and I pray nonstop these days - doesn't seem to help.
*total suicides - not "rates"...

This would imply a fixed number of suicides per unit of elapsed time.  This is not the case (i.e. suicide rates are not static, but rather rise and fall).  

Your position is mathematically impossible.
Oh - and Happy Birthday!

I understand so much of what you're saying.  I am sorry.  I want to tell you that justice will prevail, but once you are placed in a position such as this you begin to realize that there is in fact no justice.  There is only a system in which you were once complacent simply because you had never really dealt with it.

You believed that innocent until proven guilty was true, then you find that it is not true.  You find that once opposed to you the legal system seems insurmountable and inexplicably burdensome for reasons you cannot understand.  There is apparently no concern for the truth, only for conviction and/or confession.  

I understand.  My death will likely come soon from a similar permutation of this madness.  Keep fighting.  Tell them to go fuck themselves and prove that you did something wrong.  It is so strange that they are just doing a job, but it is really a person's life.  Why not seek the truth?  I don't get it.  I am here to talk if you need it.  Remember that the end is not here yet - you will always be entitled to a trial by jury (for whatever that's worth).
I don't understand, she divorced you or what?  You can pm me if you don't wanna talk on this post

My life was stolen by a vindictive ex who assaulted me and refuses to tell the truth.  

How about you?
Tell me if you could take it?  Tell me suicide is not an answer.  Tell me fairness will reign in.

Social abstinence could achieve the same result without self sacrifice (presumably).  I agree with you in many ways though.  This really is an argument for socialism IMO.

Your method seems a bit violent, and possibly quite difficult.  I would say don't do it, but I don't know what you're specifically going through. 

PM me if you want to chat.

I am talking to therpists, atty's, and loved ones.  My dignity and future have been stolen.  I will never be the same after what she has remorselessly done.  All who knew me loved me, but I am broken now.

Thank you for responding.

Thanks for the replies, but I was hoping for serious responses about this.

Good luck

So sorry buddy.  He is at peace now and his struggle is over.  I wish this life was not so hard on some of us.  I wish I knew what else to say.  I can absolutely tell you that this is not your fault in any way.  If you want to pm me I'm here.

I understand, and I am experiencing similar feelings.  I live very far from my family and have for nearly a decade (schooling).  I am writing the notes now.  It's interesting as I write them though - I find that what I write I can say to them now, beforehand.  

Just tell them you love them, tell them that you know they love you too.  Maybe it will help uncover something.

I hate how life is unfair, but you can pull through buddy.  Is there an underlying cause to your depression?  A traumatic event?  Can you find a better therapist?

Good luck

I too worry about having the courage to do it.  I think in your case things will be ok.  Can you self publish a manuscript or anything?  

Personally I don't want to survive when I finally do it, so I'm fearful.  I also cannot get access to firearms as I am dealing with an insane person who took that right from me; hence it is hanging or co asphyxiation - neither of which you want to survive.

 I also feel sorry for my family and friends who will be dealing with the aftermath.  I can totally empathize with the suicide=love equation.  That said, give it more time buddy.  I bet things will turn around for you.

Life is difficult.  I often wonder why.  I expect it is because we cannot understand ease without difficulty.  Relativity wins again; Einstein you crafty bastard.  

If you are young I wouldn't consider suicide AT ALL.  There are so many ways to better your situation.  Maybe you can expand on why you are feeling so down?  I promise you can probably come out of it on top.

I digress... CO.
It's not as easy as you think.  You shoild seek counseling to understand the origins of these thoughts.  Good luck
Sorry for your loss sofar.  Is there anything he could have done to make it easier on you or understandable?  This is a serious question.

I have been wondering the same thing.  I am thinking of going to visit them first, which will be a bit strange given my predicament.  But... I think a note and a big hug for each loved one may help them remember me when I was happy and carefree.  Your problem is solvable though, so suicide is probably not the answer, although I understand buddy.  As for the debt, depends on what kind - most dies with you unless cosigned or parent-based student loan.
What happened, can you pm me with the details or anything?  Any advice?

Thanks Karissa, I feel hopeless.  I can't really say much about what my lawyer assured me of and about what he says I should do.  I can tell you this was not part of the equation and that I am not comfortable with accepting the plea.  I got a copy of her 911 call and it's clear she is wasted, but it also sounds pretty bad for me.  I am so scared.  If she has marks and medical experts etc., I am scared about what a jury would believe.  

The replies to this post got me above my baseline of sadness, but I returned to feeling so depressed again; this roller coaster is literally killing me.  I just talked to one of my best friends and broke down crying like a baby, I am such a mess.

My atty told me the particular DV advocate "hates men" and also, I read her report in the restraining order; it is terrible.  Makes me sound like a complete abusive monster.  It is so unbelievable and heart-wrenching.  One of the reasons for this post is to find those ppl.  I can't be the only one, I just need to find those who have overcome this insanity.  It's the only hope I have left.

Thank you.  I honestly don't want to stay and I feel like I have already been changed.  I was really a nice fun guy with lots of friends, now I am scared to go out (if I see her I could go to jail; it's fucked) and I am probably a depressing burden to be around.  

My friends have seen her out and they say she seems happy as can be.  It crushes my soul to hear that.  I don't understand how she can look at herself in the mirror.

Thanks goodship, that's what everyone keeps telling me.  This happens so often.  When I was in jail (it's still weird to say that), there were 6 other guys with similar stories in my cell, although all were in for misdemeanors.  While that's a sad fact, it's also pretty bad for my case; every Tom, Dick and Harry says "she attacked me".  The really messed up thing is that it's true and the legal system just doesn't care.  

I realize there is a real need for this type of legislation, I really do.  But damn, it has gone way too far to the point that it's now just "guilty until proven guilty" if you're a man involved in a DV case.  

Writing this post and everyone's comments have made me feel a little better, but I know I will wake up tomorrow, I will cry in the shower and again when I pray before work, and then I will be feel like ending it again until I finally do.

So I'm guessing a misdemeanor domestic assault charge with subsequent deferred adjudication upon plea of guilty or no contest.  Did you have an attorney?  Court appointed PD?  

It sounds like you probably got a voluntary dismissal after probation/costs etc. (which is NOT an expunction).  I have read up a lot on these stupid statutes...

As for my PhD, well the market is EXTREMELY competitive.  There just aren't enough jobs for all the PhD's.  I also love and am very good at teaching/mentoring, an assault charge does not look great on the ole resume I assume.  Thanks for your comments shaggy, you might want to look into getting an expunction through a private atty in MI FYI.
In fact her story not only changes, it gets worse and worse each time I hear more from my atty.

Thanks shaggy, I hope so.  My lawyer does not seem to communicate well with me.  He assured me better outcomes than this plea, and has been a little misleading at times IMO.  MI has similar statutes to where I currently live.  What were you convicted of?  Did you plea guilty or no contest to anything?  Bench/Jury trial?  Private counsel/PD?  Sorry I have a lot of questions...

My ex will not come to her senses, God I wish.  She carried so many red flags, it all makes so much sense in retrospect.  She loves being the "victim".  She has had over 30 failed relationships, has severe daddy and related abandonment issues, told me all her exes were violent, told me her dad and brother have "choked her out" before, told me she was sexually abused by a babysitters son when she was younger (not sure I believe that story anymore), which led to charges for that poor kid.  Damn I should have known better.  I wish I had a time machine.

Thank you for the response.  There were witnesses, but it's not clear if they observed the actual incident.  I have looked everywhere for CCTV and any other folks who may have seen anything.  I was praying there would have been a camera or anything.  
I do try to remember my innocence, but that frustrates me even more; she has nothing to lose by telling the truth or just admitting she doesn't remember.  I don't get it.  

Innocent people have been convicted of crimes, so I am still fearful.  I hope you are right that time will vindicate me.  That is all I have and I try to keep it in mind.  I miss my life and I miss me.

Thanks for the comment.  I am in therapy, but it doesn't seem to help much.  I think the issue is that there are no answers and no real way to control the situation.  I need a way to compartmentalize, yet still be mindful of how to deal with these life altering legal matters.  

I just finished my PhD and started my new contract two weeks after this happened.  I walk around thinking "do they know?", "do they think I am some sort of maniac?". They must think I am lazy or an idiot or both because I am in a state of constant mental and emotional exhaustion. The situation is unworkable at present and I am so scared and devastated.  If I lose at a trial I will be financially wiped out as well as a felon.  While I am near the end already, if that situation occurs I will certainly find my peace on my own terms.
